name: propusher
description: Build and edit exercises, workouts, programs, questionnaires and exercise animations in your Propusher coaching library.

interface.longDescription: For coaches who use Propusher. Find, create and edit exercises, workout templates, multi-week programs and questionnaires in your library, and animate exercises with a 3D figure. New items are saved straight away; edits wait as drafts until you apply them in Propusher. Clients, teams and calendars are not reachable, and nothing is deleted.
defaultPrompt: Build a 45-minute lower-body strength workout from my Propusher exercises.
Make a 4-week beginner running program in Propusher.
Write a weekly check-in questionnaire for my clients.
